concerns.text: Verification for T006 expects `contracts/target_decision.schema.yaml` to exist, but this schema is only added later in Phase 8 (T013). The contract test will fail at execution time because the required schema is missing when T006 runs.

Task T011 uses the NIST PCM dataset for external validation, whereas Constitution Principle VII mandates validation against an independent literature set of ~50 PCMs. This violates the project's independent physical validation requirement.

The verification for T010 checks false‑positive rate change and R² variation, but does not verify the success criterion SC‑007 (that R² variation across label thresholds must be ≤ 0.05). Without an explicit check, the task does not guarantee measurement of this success criterion.
